部分插件、字体和图片的许可信息尚未齐备，本表不代表全部素材都已取得再分发许可。当前文件暂不作为正式公开发行包提供。第三方许可原文保留其原有语言和内容。

The components listed above retain their own copyright and licenses. InkTag project terms do not relicense them. See the linked license texts and [CLI third-party notices](cli/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). The complete CLI bundle also supplies the license for its Find query component.

License information for some plugins, fonts and images is not yet complete; this list does not grant redistribution rights to every asset. The current files are not yet offered as a formal public release. Original third-party license texts are retained in their original form and language.

licenses/release-materials.txt

# CLI 源码与组件 / CLI source and components

CLI 包含 Python 源代码、JavaScript 组件和编译后的图形渲染组件。InkTag 自有 CLI 源码采用 [PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0](cli/LICENSE)，第三方组件保留原许可。

当前包可以查看 Python 源码，但尚未提供渲染组件的完整对应源码、字体输入资料及重新编译说明。它不是完整的对应源码包；需要修改或重新编译这些组件时，请等待项目提供相应下载及说明。WebUI 源码不在本期提供范围内。

完整许可边界见[许可说明](LICENSING.md)，现有组件与许可正文见[第三方声明](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

The CLI contains Python source, JavaScript components and a compiled graphics renderer. InkTag-owned CLI source uses [PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0](cli/LICENSE); third-party components retain their own licenses.

You can inspect the Python source in the current package, but complete renderer Corresponding Source, font inputs and rebuild instructions are not yet provided. This is not a complete Corresponding Source package. If you need to modify or rebuild those components, wait for the relevant downloads and instructions. WebUI source is not included in this release.

See [licensing](LICENSING.md) and [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for the applicable terms and supplied license texts.

licenses/WenQuanYi-Bitmap-Song-NOTICE.txt

WenQuanYi Bitmap Song — font attribution and license
文泉驿点阵宋体 — 字体版权与许可

The existing Chinese glyph-supplementation catalog contains two Bold faces:
WQY9: 12-pixel / 9-point Bold; WQY12: 16-pixel / 12-point Bold.
Font family: WenQuanYi Bitmap Song; foundry: WenQuanYi;
font metadata version: 000.990 (WenQuanYi release 0.9.9).
Each catalog face contains 27,535 codepoints, from U+3000 through U+9FA5.
These are font data, not a new font family or a grant for InkTag-owned code.

原有中文补字目录含 WQY9 与 WQY12 两套粗体，每套 27,535 个字形。
字体许可独立于 WebUI、U8g2 代码及其他组件的许可。
